label: In Fine's pure logic of ground, for every type of atoms and every PLG-consistent set S of assumed…
paraphrase: In Fine's pure logic of ground, for every type of atoms and every PLG-consistent set S of assumed sequents: no atom reaches itself by a finite chain of strict partial grounds derivable from S; no derivable strict partial ground A ≺ B has a derivable reversal B ≼ A; and, if there are only finitely many atoms, derivable strict partial ground from S is well-founded. It does not say that any S is consistent or that actual ground is acyclic.
